adversarial_assessment: The ordinary official statistic for Stickstoffduengerabsatz is nitrogen-nutrient domestic sales. That convention fits the surrounding nutrient-efficiency discussion. A product-mass series would be a different quantity and is not identified or qualified in the submission. Do not claim an uncited source was directly copied.
Rounding and the provisional marking do not explain a 5.6 percentagepoint gap. Both per-hectare definitions in the same table also fall near 37%, not 43%.

A plausible benign clerical explanation exists: a 2014/15 baseline 1822.8 produces almost exactly 43%with the 2023/24 endpoint. A primary BMEL 2022 table separately identifies that 2014/15 value and confirms 2016/17=1658.8. This does not rescue the years actually printed and no source-chain or intent inference follows.

The claim is an introductory progress statistic. The request has legal, administrative and fairness arguments too, and the corrected 37.4%fall remains large. No causal judgment about law effectiveness or water quality follows.
The adjacent 109 to 63 nitrogen-surplus fall is approximately 42%; do not conflate the two series or promote the separate target-date claim without resolving averaging labels.
